name: proto-blocks/cadco-prose-columns
title: Cadco Prose Columns
description: An optional section heading above two columns of rich text, with an optional button under the left column.

heading.label: Section heading
heading.help: Optional. Leave empty where the columns carry their own headings, as the warranty coverage section does.

left.label: Left column
left.help: Headings, paragraphs and lists together. Write it as one region rather than as separate fields, so the order is yours to change.

callout.label: Callout under the right column
callout.help: Optional. Drawn as a tinted box with a blue rule, for a note that should not read as part of the column's prose.

cta.label: Button under the left column
cta.help: Optional. A telephone link is written as tel:8776037693.

ctaStyle.label: Button style
ctaStyle.help: The warranty page draws its service line as an outlined button with a handset beside it.

leftMeasure.label: Left column measure
leftMeasure.help: How wide the left column runs before its copy wraps. The warranty page uses both: the coverage copy runs wide, the additional information narrow. The wide measure is set to the frame's own line breaks, which sit in a narrow band -- changing it a few pixels moves a word between lines.
